name: HTTP Request Smuggling & Desync Vulnerability Auditor
description: High-impact HTTP request smuggling vulnerability auditor for bug bounty hunters. Detects CL.TE, TE.CL, TE.TE obfuscations, and HTTP/2 downgrade desync anomalies across reverse proxies and CDNs without causing backend disruption.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

test_cl_te.description: Test Content-Length vs Transfer-Encoding (CL.TE) desync discrepancies

test_te_cl.description: Test Transfer-Encoding vs Content-Length (TE.CL) desync discrepancies

test_te_obfuscation.description: Evaluate Transfer-Encoding header obfuscation (TE: chunked, Transfer-Encoding: xchunked)
